title: Ahlul Bayt and Their Authority — Part 241

sentences.en:
But since he had no inclination towards this temporal
world, he voluntarily refrained from eating wheat.

(The point of ‘Ali's remark was that excellence of a man
before Allah lies in piety and devotion, and that the height of piety lies in abstaining even from what is
permissible.)
Sa'sa'a asked: "Who is superior, you or Noah?"

Noah called his men to
worship Allah, but they did not obey.
Their shameful mistreatment was torture to him.

He cursed them
and invoked Allah: 'O my Lord!
Leave not on the earth a single person of the unjust ones.'

After the
death of the Prophet, even though the people caused me extreme difficulty, I never cursed them.

I
suffered their torment with patience."
Sa'sa'a asked: "Who is superior, you or Abraham?"

‘Ali replied: "I am superior, for Abraham said:
'My Lord!
Show me how Thou Givest life to the dead.'
